text.description_html:
RK International CK-9220, Deco Two-Toned Cabinet Knob

The Deco Cabinet Knob With Polished Brass Accent is a fun way to show your love of days gone by. We imagine this knob in a swanky beach home in Miami's Art-Deco area but its style can bring the feel of Miami Beach to any home. The knob is available in oil rubbed bronze with a polished brass base or satin nickel with a polished brass base.

Also Available: Matching Deco Two-Toned Cabinet Pull

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-9220 Retro Cabinet Knob with Brass Accent:

  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Material: brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Oil Rubbed Bronze with Polished Brass

Satin Nickel with Polished Brass

Sold Individually
